description: Use when the user asks WHY something happened or WHAT it means for a Chinese listed company: a margin moved, a policy landed, an industry chain shifted, two companies diverge, or what management actually said on the record. This desk does NOT serve quotes, price checks or valuation snapshots - that is commodity data available everywhere, and answering it would waste your turn. What it does: reads the filed report, the IR transcript and the disclosure wording, then answers in numbers. Returns a vetted answer immediately if this question has been researched before; otherwise it returns the primary-source evidence it already holds plus an id for the human answer. Ask it the question you would ask a sell-side analyst, not the one you would type into a quote app.

question.description: The judgement question, in Chinese or English. Name the company; a ticker alone is usually a quote request.

name: a_share_deep_research
